title: Storz & Bickel XL Acrylic 3 pc Herb Grinder
description:
Storz & Bickel XL Herb Mill
If you have large amounts of herb to grind look no further then this very affordable and very effective acrylic herb grinder. This acrylic grinder is packed full of ultra sharp acrylic teeth and will shred the toughest of herb to a fine fluffy consistency.
The S&B  XL grinder is 100% acrylic and as far as acrylic grinders go it is one of the best. Besides grinding your herb in preparation for vaporizing it also has a storage compartment in the lid.
Dimensions
Diameter: 80mm
Includes
﻿1
﻿x S&B XL Herb Grinder
